rows.note: Use this for a fan of a sports team or sportsperson.

example.english: I’m a supporter of this team.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 ni1 deoi6 bo1 ge3 kau4 mai4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a person backing a cause, movement, or political party.

example.english: I’m a supporter of this movement.
example.traditional: 我係呢個運動嘅支持者。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai6 ni1 go3 wan6 dung6 ge3 zi1 ci4 ze2

rows.note: Use this for an attendant or escort accompanying someone at an event or ceremony.

example.english: The organizers arranged a supporter to accompany them at the ceremony.
example.traditional: 大會安排陪同者陪佢出席典禮。
example.jyutping: daai6 wui6 on1 paai4 pui4 tung4 ze2 pui4 keoi5 ceot1 zik6 din2 lai5

rows.note: Use this for a physical object that props up or supports something else.

example.english: A supporter needs to be added under this wooden board.
example.traditional: 呢塊木板下面要加支撐物。
example.jyutping: ni1 faai3 muk6 baan2 haa6 min6 jiu3 gaa1 zi1 caang1 mat6
